source: notebooks/accounts_payable_pipeline.ipynb (cells 26, 28, 29; validated Phase 2 entry point preprocess_document; cross-checked against docs/modularisation_map.md §1.3, §10.2)
purpose: Phase 2 preprocessing parity baseline for the four controlled fixtures declared in tests/fixtures/invoices/manifest.json, fed through the Phase 1 -> Phase 2 bridge (build_preprocessing_input, decision D-6).

config.note: Cell-31 validated PreprocessingConfig instance (docs/modularisation_map.md §1.3): every field at its dataclass default except the corrected resolution thresholds from cell 29.

notes: batch_id and every document_id are reused unchanged from tests/golden/phase_1_expected_results.json: the Phase 1 -> Phase 2 bridge (build_preprocessing_input) copies identity.batch_id/document_id from the Phase 1 IngestionResult verbatim.

width/height/brightness_score/contrast_score/blur_score/detected_skew_angle/quality_flags are Tier X (exact) in the modularisation map (§10.2) and were reproduced exactly (no tolerance needed) in this repository's pinned CI environment (opencv-python-headless, numpy, Pillow versions recorded in docs/m4_phase_2_preprocessing_report.md). A test environment with different image-library versions should still match within +/-0.01 (documented tolerance, R-06); only the status/flags/counts are unconditionally required.

processed_image_sha256 and original_render_sha256 are recorded here as the values observed in this repository's pinned CI environment. They are Tier X only in a pinned environment (R-06): PNG-encoder bytes are not guaranteed identical across opencv/numpy/Pillow versions even when the decoded pixels and quality metrics match exactly. Tests must not require these two hashes outside the pinned environment; sha256 continuity (processed hash recorded in the persisted JSON equals the actual file's hash) is what integration tests assert, not equality with a fixed third-party value.
None of these values are hardcoded in src/ap_agent: they live only here and in the test suite (D-2/D-3).
